_comment: Example gov-api source. Copy this file to gov-data-sources.json, replace resourceId with a real resource ID you've verified on your own data.gov.in account (browse https://www.data.gov.in/sector/Infrastructure or search a scheme like PMGSY, then copy the resource id from the dataset's URL). apiKey is NOT set here — it comes from GOV_DATA_API_KEY at sync time.
Example file-url source — for datasets only published as a bulk CSV/XLSX/ZIP download (e.g. NDAP, PMGSY GeoSadak) rather than a keyed API. No API key needed.
